source_data.name: Chain Devil

actions.desc: One inanimate, unattended chain within 60 feet sprouts blades and magically animates under the devils control for 1 hour. It has AC 20 and 20 hit points, a Speed of 0, and immunity to psychic, piercing, poison, and thunder damage. When the devil uses Multiattack, the devil may command the chain to make one Chain attack against a target within 15 feet of it. If the chain is reduced to 0 hit points, it can't be reanimated.

actions.name: Animate Chain

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained. Until the grapple ends  this chain can only attack the grappled target.

actions.name: Chain

actions.desc: The chain devil makes two chain attacks and commands up to two animated chains under its control to make chain attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: When damaged by a creature within 30 feet that can see the devil, the devil momentarily assumes the magical illusory form of one of the attackers enemies or loved ones, alive or dead. The illusory figure may speak words that only the attacker can hear. The attacker makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn.The attacker is then immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

*Среднее Исчадие (дьявол), Принципиально-злой*

- **Класс Доспеха:** 16 (природный доспех)
- **Хиты:** 85 (10к8 + 40)
- **Скорость:** 30 фт.

| СИЛ      | ЛОВ      | ТЕЛ      | ИНТ      | МДР      | ХАР      |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| 18 (+4)  | 15 (+2)  | 18 (+4)  | 11 (+0)  | 12 (+1)  | 14 (+2)  |

- **Спасброски:** Тел +7, Мдр +4, Хар +5
- **Сопротивление к урону:** Холод; Дробящий, Колющий и Рубящий от немагических атак, не нанесённых посеребрённым оружием
- **Иммунитет к урону:** Огонь, Яд
- **Иммунитет к состояниям:** Отравленный
- **Чувства:** тёмное зрение 120 фт.; Пассивная Внимательность 11
- **Языки:** Инфернальный, телепатия 120 фт.
- **Показатель опасности:** 8 (3 900 ОО)
ru.name: Цепной дьявол
